flipToBack.timing: VOLUNTARY top-level action (TopLevelGameTextAction, player-chosen, not a trigger), usable only during your turn; no once-per limit coded
flipToBack.prose: MAY flip during your turn if Luke is on Dagobah. Implemented as a top-level game-text action, not a table-changed trigger - Rando must actively take the action.

flipToFront.timing: NEVER. Back has no flip trigger and no lose condition. On the flip itself (cardFlipped), a REQUIRED trigger fires.
flipToFront.prose: On cardFlipped: required action returns Luke and any cards on him to owner's hand (ReturnCardToHandFromTableEffect on Filters.findFirstActive(game, self, Filters.Luke), Zone.HAND for attached cards too), if Luke is on table.

requirementSemantics: Flip is a VOLUNTARY top-level action with turn-timing (isDuringYourTurn) - no automatic state-based flip exists; if Rando never takes the action, the card never flips.
Luke leg is presence-on-planet + targetability semantics: canTarget(Filters.and(Filters.Luke, Filters.On_Dagobah)) - Luke anywhere on Dagobah; no control/occupy requirement.
Flip consequence (back cardFlipped required trigger): Luke and all cards on him return to owner's HAND - the flip 'spends' Luke's board position, and the back then re-deploys Luke as a 'react' at -3.

The front's character purge is a required continuous enforcement, not a one-shot: on every table change, ALL your non-[Dagobah] characters of ability > 4 (except Ahsoka) currently active are lost (Filters.filterActive on Filters.and(Filters.your(playerId), Filters.not(Icon.DAGOBAH), Filters.abilityMoreThan(4), Filters.not(Filters.Ahsoka))). This modifier lives in an until-end-of-game action proxy, so it persists on the BACK side too.
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.character, Filters.at(Filters.non_battleground_location)) may not be targeted by Filters.Sense (both sides)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Beldon's Corridor, Yoda's Hut with [Dagobah] Yoda there (DeployCardToLocationFromReserveDeckEffect), [Cloud City] No Disintegrations!, and Patience! from Reserve Deck (front:52-90).

Front + back shared (same GameTextActionId.MIND_WHAT_YOUR_HAVE_LEARNED_V__DOWNLOAD_BESPIN_LOCATION): once per turn, deploy Bespin system or a Cloud City site from Reserve Deck (front:132-147; BACK:110-125).
Front only: may deploy Wise Advice or Yoda's Hope from Reserve Deck (no once-per-turn usage limit coded; gated only by canDeployCardFromReserveDeck) (front:149-160).
Front only: once per turn, deploy a Dagobah location from Reserve Deck (front:162-176).
Back: may place a completed Jedi Test (even if suspended) out of play to take a [Cloud City] Rebel into hand from Lost Pile (BACK:127-152).
otherObligations: Both sides, remainder-of-game equivalents (modifiers repeated on both cards): Sense may not target characters at non-battlegrounds; you may not Force drain on Dagobah (front:202-203; BACK:88-89).
Continuous purge (until end of game, set by front's deployment-completed proxy): your non-[Dagobah] characters of ability > 4 (except Ahsoka) are lost on every table change (front:93-126).
Back, on flip: Luke and cards on him return to owner's hand (BACK:59-79).
Back: may deploy Luke (deploy -3) and/or a weapon on him as a 'react' (BACK:92-93).

Back: when your [Cloud City] Rebel Force drains at a battleground site, unless a captive on table, opponent's lost Force must come from top of Reserve Deck if possible (SpecialFlagModifier FORCE_DRAIN_LOST_FROM_RESERVE_DECK with DuringForceDrainAtCondition(sameSiteAs [Cloud City] Rebel battleground site) AND UnlessCondition(OnTableCondition INCLUDE_CAPTIVE Filters.captive), BACK:95-101).
Strategic note from law: flip is free of board-state risk (no flip-back), but returns Luke to hand - flip when Luke's Dagobah training job is done and the Cloud City drain engine is ready.
